challenges.name: typed-order-pipeline
challenges.title: Build a typed order pipeline from an untrusted event log
challenges.description: Put the whole course together. The Chợ Sớm event log has one JSON event per line - placed, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled - and nothing in it is trusted. Write parseEvent, which checks a line from unknown into the OrderEvent discriminated union (or null), apply, which moves an order through its states (placed, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled with a refund) and returns an error message for every impossible transition or wrong payment, and describe, which writes the report line for each state. Use exhaustive switches with assertNever, and no any or as. The test runner replays the log, prints the rejected lines and errors, then every order and the totals.
